issues.description: Synchronous model.predict() call blocks the main execution thread, directly competing with the 100ms budget required for 10Hz operation.
Disk I/O for cache validation and JSON read/write introduces unpredictable latency spikes that violate hard real-time constraints on mobile robot compute.
Computing MD5 hash on full frame bytes via frame_bgr.tobytes() adds significant CPU overhead per cycle, increasing inference latency.
No batch processing or asynchronous inference pipeline implemented; GPU throughput is underutilized due to single-frame synchronous execution.
